reviews.note: Rejected for `sad`: the full ayah - 'Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best trustee' - is the believers' composed answer to news that a hostile force had massed against them. On review it reads primarily as a response to acute threat, betrayal by circumstance, and being outnumbered/opposed, rather than to grief or sadness as such. Preserved as an overlap proposal for `afraid`, `anxious`, `betrayed`, `wronged`, `overwhelmed`, `reassurance`, `strength`, `weak`, `hopeful`, `closer_to_allah`, and `seeking_guidance`. Explicitly NOT carried forward as an overlap for `rejected`.

Rejected for `lonely`: the full ayah - 'hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided... He brought your hearts together and you became, by His favour, brothers' - is addressed to the community as a whole (a collective unity instruction) rather than to an individual's felt experience of being alone. Preserved as an overlap proposal for `sad`, `hopeful`, `reassurance`, `content`, `peaceful`, `closer_to_allah`, `seeking_guidance`, and `confused`.
